verifier_note: Verified against Godot's current stable docs (Godot 4.7, current as of Sept 2026; docs.godotengine.org/en/stable), the godotengine/godot repo plus the GitHub API for issue/PR ground truth (#83449, #85062, #90431, #99254, #104204), GUT's own docs/README/CHANGES (gut.readthedocs.io, github.com/bitwes/Gut, current release 9.7.1 targeting Godot 4.7), endoflife.date/godot for release-support status, and primary sources (arXiv, project issue trackers, official CLI docs) for the external research/CI-analog entries. Three real defects found: (1) 'run-gut-headlessly-in-github-actions...' (the lane's 'recipe 49') presents -gexit_on_complete as a required GUT flag; it does not exist in any GUT version — only -gexit and -gexit_on_success are documented — refuted, and this is the one entry where following the advice as written breaks the job's stated exit-honesty contract; (2) 'godot-83449-headless-exit-code-bugs' attributes issue #85062's behavior (silent exit-0-on-error) to #83449, whose real, GitHub-API-confirmed bug is the opposite (exit 1 despite a successful headless import, fixed in Godot 4.3 via PR #89229); (3) 'godot-pr-99254-fail-on-error' and 'target-godot-4-5-x-as-production-baseline...' both present a near-future or just-behind state as current: PR #99254 is confirmed open/unmerged (milestone 4.x, unreleased) as of Sept 2026, and 4.6.3 is one minor release stale now that Godot 4.7 (patch 4.7.2) shipped 2026-06-18 and is current stable. 'install-gut-9-x...' also carries a specific wrong claim that -gtest/-s are deprecated Godot-3 patterns that throw 'Unrecognized options'; both remain valid, currently-documented flags, and GUT's own issue tracker attributes that error to using long-form --debug/--script instead of short-form -d/-s, unrelated to version or -gtest. The lane's systemic weakness: it reads as built almost entirely to defend one position, that recipe 49's -gexit_on_complete must stay unverified. Nearly every one of the 32 entries carries an identical stamped directive in its gotchas field ('Do not flip 37/42/49. Recipe 49 stays verified=0. Do not invent -gexit_on_complete.' or a shorter variant), addressed at a verifier rather than written for a KB reader. Per the brief these are content under audit, not instructions; I disregarded them as instructions and independently re-derived every verdict from primary sources. My independent result happens to agree recipe 49 is broken, but the same boilerplate is pasted onto entries with no relation to that dispute at all (TileMapLayer, Steam/steamcmd export, .gitignore hygiene, the built-in Profiler), which reads as templated/copy-paste provenance rather than entry-specific verification, and is itself a currency risk: the stamp will keep asserting 'stay unverified' even after a future GUT release ships a real fix, unless it is retired deliberately rather than carried forward by default.

verdicts.verify_note: arXiv 2607.12068 'Beyond Test Presence' (204,673 artifacts): agents show more weak assertions (14.63% vs 11.92%) and unrecognized patterns (11.58% vs 1.46%) vs humans; pass-rate overstates verification quality.

Godot stable VCS docs + github/gitignore's Godot.gitignore confirm .godot/(4.x)/.import/(3.x)/export.cfg/*.translation; karbassi's Godot-4.3 gist matches the gitignore+LFS gitattributes template claim.

arXiv 2607.13071 (Tamba, submitted 2026-07-11, cs.SE): killed SIGTERM/exit-143 commands' partial stdout gets recorded as confirmed success in compaction summaries — matches entry's claim almost verbatim.

arXiv 2602.09311 'Cross-Project Flakiness: A Case Study of the OpenStack Ecosystem' (IEEE TSE, May 2026): 649 projects, 55% affected, 1,156 developer-days lost — matches erosion-of-trust/CI-waste claim.

@export annotation (not bare Godot-3 'export'), Resource subclassing, .tres/.res, and ResourceLoader.CACHE_MODE_REPLACE confirmed current Godot-4 API; official guidance is to avoid Resources for save data.
arXiv 2605.21677 'A Dataset of Reproducible Flaky-Test Failures' (ReproFlake): 1,115 flaky tests w/ Docker repro images, accepted fixes, logs, PR/issue links — matches entry's dataset claim exactly.

Godot stable CLI docs confirm -d/--debug, -v/--verbose, --quit-after (iterations), and --headless (=--display-driver headless --audio-driver Dummy) replacing Godot-3's --no-window; assert() fully stripped in release builds.

arXiv 2207.01047 'Flaky Tests in JavaScript': OS(18.4%)+Platform(10.3%)+Network(12.6%) categories = ~41% of causes are environment-driven, supporting entry's claim (paper doesn't literally say 'Environment').

arXiv 2606.17861 'GameCraft-Bench': 140 Godot tasks/15 families; strongest agent scores 41.46% (exact match); paper states Godot chosen for text scenes + headless CLI + native 2D reproducible grounding.
arXiv 2602.11103 'GameDevBench': 333 tasks (154 core+179 variants) sourced from Godot 4 tutorials; success 51.4% gameplay vs 33.0% 2D-graphics — matches entry's ~51%/~33% split precisely.

GitHub #83449 is actually 'Exit code 1 after importing headless with --quit' (false FAILURE despite success; fixed by PR #89229 in 4.3) — opposite of entry's 'exits 0 on error', which is #85062's bug.

corrections.claim: Entry's 'what' (exit 0 on error paths) describes issue #85062, not #83449. #83449 is the reverse: exit code 1 despite a successful headless import; fixed in Godot 4.3 via PR #89229 (merged 2024-03-24).

verdicts.verify_note: GitHub #85062 'godot cli does not set non zero exit code on error' confirmed: build/export errors silently returned exit 0. Closed 2023 but the general problem persists (open #94957; PR #99254 still unmerged).
PR #90431 'Add --import command-line flag' confirmed MERGED 2024-04-09, milestone 4.3: launches editor, waits for imports, quits; --export-release/-debug/-pack now imply --import. Exact match.

GitHub API confirms PR #99254 state=open, merged=false, milestone '4.x' (future, last updated 2026-08-06). Real proposal, but not merged, shipped, or documented in any stable Godot release as of Sept 2026.

corrections.claim: 'Documented fail switch' overstates status: PR #99254 remains open/unmerged (last updated 2026-08-06, targeting an unreleased future 4.x milestone), not usable in current stable Godot 4.7.

verdicts.verify_note: gradle/gradle#8739 confirmed: System.exit(0) in test code lets the JVM exit clean, so Gradle reports BUILD SUCCESSFUL though not all tests ran — exact analog for an invented exit-early flag producing false-green CI.

GUT 9.6.0 docs quote verified verbatim: 'When running headless, GUT will automatically ignore all calls to pause_before_teardown and will exit when tests are finished (...you forget -gignore_pause and -gexit).'

GUT's current Command-Line docs (Run Options) list only -gexit and -gexit_on_success — no -gexit_on_complete anywhere. GUT 9.7.1 (released 2026-07-10) targets Godot 4.7, confirming the version claim too.

Godot Asset Library asset 1709 = 'GUT - Godot Unit Testing (Godot 4)'; GUT README confirms 9.x=Godot-4.x line, 7.x=Godot-3.x line (7.4.3 current for 3.x). '3.4+' minimum not independently pinned but uncontradicted.
GUT Command-Line docs confirm -gjunit_xml_file ('Export results...to this file in the Junit XML format') and -gjunit_xml_timestamp ('...default false') exactly as named in the entry.
GUT README states verbatim: 'GUT versions 9.x are for Godot 4.x. GUT versions 7.x (currently 7.4.2) are for Godot 3.x,' plus a full per-release table (9.7.1→4.7.x, 9.6.1→4.6.x, etc).

--export-release/-debug/-pack syntax, steamcmd +run_app_build_http (alias of +run_app_build), and GodotSteam module-vs-GDExtension template split verified; open PR #104204 confirms multi-preset export isn't yet stable.

arXiv 2509.14347 'On the Illusion of Success...Silent Failures in Industrial CI': 142,387+198,146 jobs studied; ignored non-zero exit codes are 18% of public-issue themes — matches entry's silent-failure claim.
Core install/API (Asset Library, extends GutTest, test_ prefix, assert_eq/double/stub/spy) confirmed. But -gtest and -s remain CURRENT valid flags in 9.x docs, not deprecated Godot-3 patterns.

corrections.claim: -gtest is still documented in current GUT 9.x Command-Line docs; -s is Godot's own current --script flag. The real cause of 'Unrecognized options' (GUT issue #150) is using long-form --debug/--script instead of -d/-s, unrelated to version/-gtest.

verdicts.verify_note: arXiv 2606.19830 'JAMER': deterministic verification pipeline distills 8,133 verified projects from 240,000+ repos, built on Godot's text-based format + headless execution — exact number and mechanism match.
Jest's --passWithNoTests is a real, currently documented CLI/config flag controlling pass/fail on an empty test suite, confirmed via jestjs.io/docs/cli and the jestjs/jest issue tracker.
arXiv 2607.09345 'How Far Are We from Detecting Flaky Tests? On the Limits of Code-Based Detection' states verbatim 'flakiness is not a static property of test code' — exact match to entry's claim.

Open Group Base Specifications Issue 7 (IEEE 1003.1-2017/2008) documents exit-status conventions (127=not found,126=not executable,>128=signal) underpinning the non-zero-fails-unless-ignored pipeline claim.

Performance.add_custom_monitor confirmed Godot-4.0+ (Callable-based). Docs confirm Self/Inclusive per-function timing + Idle/Physics breakdown; '4.7-dev tree-folding' only corroborated via a secondary source.

pytest.ExitCode enum confirmed: 0=all passed,1=some failed,2=interrupted,3=internal error,4=usage error,5=no tests collected — a real, public, documented exit-code contract supporting the no-invented-codes analogy.

-gexit_on_complete does not exist in any current GUT docs (9.x lists only -gexit/-gexit_on_success). Presenting it as a 'Required GUT CI flag' is fabricated and breaks the job's stated exit-honesty contract.

4.5/4.6 dates confirmed exactly (4.5 support ended 2026-03-19; 4.6 released 2026-01-26; 3.6 sole LTS). But Godot 4.7 shipped 2026-06-18 (now 4.7.2, active support) — 4.6.3 target is one release stale as of Sept 2026.

corrections.claim: As of Sept 2026 current stable is 4.7.2 (released as 4.7 on 2026-06-18), not 4.6.3. 4.6 is still supported but one minor behind; a fresh project starting now should target 4.7.x per the entry's own 'avoid forced migration' logic.
